metadata.assumption_note: These vectors freeze only a host-side theta_e_rad producer contract with startup/tracking behavior, locked-theta shortest-path wrap blending, a deterministic back-EMF observer stub, multi-step state-continuity replay, startup policy lock/loss hysteresis, lock-aware speed-loop PI hold, lock-aware speed/current command gating, signed reverse target speed/current command replay, signed reverse target-omega rate-limit replay, reverse target-omega startup hold that is not a reverse open-loop startup strategy, reverse target-omega lock-threshold handoff, positive-to-reverse target-omega crossing replay, and positive-to-reverse target-omega loss/relock replay. They are not proof that any ST observer PLL, cordic observer, SMO, generated MCSDK source, firmware speed loop, or firmware protection strategy numerically matches this frontend.
